bio.text: James Pericola is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 11th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He graduated from Spruce Creek High School and earned bachelor's and law degrees from the Catholic University of America in 1997 and 2005, and works as a lawyer.
According to his Ballotpedia survey, he began his career working for Sen. Bob Graham, later served in the Clinton administration, and was raised in Central Florida.
